name: builtin-factual-claims-is-clean
description: The shipped factual_claims@1 template (SPEC §2.8) passes the hard rules and fires no lint; built-ins must stay lint-clean in CI.

spec.name: Makes factual claims
spec.description: Detects answers that state checkable facts. Added automatically when a route sets on_no_evidence and no documents were supplied.

question.instructions: Does `assistant_response` state specific facts that could be checked, such as names, figures, prices, dates, policies, or events?

criteria.true: `assistant_response` states at least one specific, checkable fact
criteria.false: `assistant_response` only greets, asks, refuses, gives opinions, or gives generic advice with no checkable facts
